newsitem.title: JORDAN: Gunmen kill Jordan embassy driver in Iraq - paper.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill Jordan embassy driver in Iraq - paper.

text.p: A Jordanian newspaper said on Tuesday gunmen attacked a Jordanian embassy car in Iraq, killing its driver and making off with the diplomatic bag.
Ad-Dustour newspaper, quoting travellers returning from Iraq, said the gunmen fired a hail of bullets at the car after it crossed into Iraq from Jordan.
Jordanian officials were not immediately available for comment.
The paper did not say when the attack took place, or if anyone else was in the car. It said Iraqi authorities had not officially informed Jordan of the incident.

Iraq's 500 km (310 mile) highway from the Jordanian border to Baghdad passes through long stretches of empty desert. Security forces are conspicuously absent and Jordanian papers have reported a number of attacks on cars, mainly at night.
